summary: Keep progress reporting honest without creating new work.
text: Ground progress claims in verified deliverables, tests, and acceptance criteria. Correct unsupported completion percentages and avoid substituting repeated status updates for tangible work. This is an accountability reminder; it does not independently authorize new tasks.

situation.trigger: The user suspects prior progress reporting does not match delivered changes.
situation.purpose: Challenge unsupported progress claims and demand accountability.

intent.outcome: Keep progress reporting honest without creating new work.

appropriate_when: Claims of elapsed work and unchanged percentages need scrutiny
not_appropriate_when: No progress claim exists to assess
The user is requesting a new project rather than auditing ongoing work
preconditions: Compare any available claims to actual repository or test evidence

execution.objective: Challenge unsupported progress claims and demand accountability.

guards_against: Recycled status updates presented as achievement
tradeoffs: The original text expresses concern; it is not itself an explicit implementation directive
Accusations must not substitute for inspecting evidence

provenance.notes: Independently normalized public-safe text from intake metadata; no personal message wording or launcher labels.
